## Use this when

- find a hard-to-source part
- find a discontinued part
- source an obsolete component
- find a supersession or cross reference
- find a donor or salvage part
- find a blueprint or fabrication path
- source new old stock or aftermarket replacement
- normal part searches failed and I need deeper sourcing

## Problem

A difficult, identified-enough physical part is still blocking a repair, restoration, machine or project after ordinary sourcing has failed or deeper cross-reference, salvage, documentation, blueprint or fabrication work is needed.

## Inputs

Part description plus any known equipment identity, model/serial/part numbers, photos, measurements or functional clues.

## Outputs

Evidence-backed paid sourcing hunt with tier-dependent source lanes, customer-safe Part Passport state, candidate source evidence, verification state, and escalation paths when ordinary sourcing fails.

## Pricing

Quick Hunt $19 one-time; Deep Hunt $49 one-time; Rescue Hunt $99 one-time.

- Quick Hunt:  (one_time)

- Deep Hunt:  (one_time)

- Rescue Hunt:  (one_time)

## Invocation and authority

LIVE: direct FindMyPart MCP exposes free Part Passport triage, current paid offers, human-confirmed checkout preparation, and private-token hunt status. Use free_part_triage first when identity or sourcing path is unclear. Paid fulfillment still requires authoritative provider verification.

User must explicitly choose an offer and confirm payment. Paid fulfillment starts only after independently verified payment.

Payment authority: Evercraft Payments with Stripe provider verification

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Human confirmation is required before checkout where checkout exists. Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
